rapport_notes: Patient and respectful of the customer's need to comparison-shop, offering a clear no-pressure follow-up path.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move?' asked right after date/profile setup, before logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'Just needing help moving, just a couple of large items. That's my biggest concern.' Rep: 'we are definitely equipped to move big items... I can definitely help you with that' — one reassurance, no immediate follow-up tying back to the stated concern (the furniture inventory was taken later as standard logistics, not as a continuation of this concern).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'let's say everything will be done in just two and a half hours, then we'll only charge you for two and a half hours' (pay-less-if-faster concept); no rate-commit, window, self-prep, or feel-fair lines.

top_strength: Made a confident, direct close ask ('would you like to go ahead and get it scheduled today, Yolanda?') and handled the 'I want to compare other quotes' objection without pressure.
coaching_note: The stated concern about 'large items' got a reassurance but not a real second-layer follow-up in the moment (e.g., 'which large items, any special handling needs?') — it was addressed only later as generic inventory-taking.
